input: Install a smart thermostat in the hallway

gold.taskTitle: Install a Smart Thermostat in the Hallway
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to install a smart thermostat in their hallway, replacing or adding to their existing heating and cooling setup.

questions.title: Which smart thermostat brand or model do you have?
questions.description: Identify the specific thermostat product to tailor installation steps accurately.

questions.title: Are you replacing an existing thermostat or installing fresh?
questions.description: Determine whether there is an old unit to remove or if this is a brand-new installation point.

questions.title: What type of heating and cooling system do you have?
questions.description: Identify the HVAC system type (e.g., forced air, heat pump, boiler) as wiring varies significantly.

questions.title: Do you have a C-wire at the current thermostat location?
questions.description: Establish whether a common wire is present, which most smart thermostats require for power.

questions.title: What is your comfort level with electrical wiring work?
questions.description: Gauge the user's DIY experience to determine how detailed the guidance needs to be.

questions.title: Which Wi-Fi or smart home platform should it connect to?
questions.description: Identify the ecosystem (e.g., Google Home, Amazon Alexa, Apple HomeKit) for setup and integration steps.

questions.title: Is there a specific deadline or date to complete this?
questions.description: Understand any time constraints so the plan can be prioritised and scheduled accordingly.
